responsibility: Implements the i386/x86 common target option layer by defining ISA implication masks, the table of recognized processor and microarchitecture aliases for -march and -mtune, and the TARGET_GET_VALID_OPTION_VALUES hook that exposes those names to GCC’s option machinery. This file is the shared option/name registry for x86 CPU and ISA selection rather than the backend file that expands instructions or builtins.
